declarations.name: FluentIcon
declarations.description: An accessible, decorative-by-default Fluent System Icon. Register imported families or enable the optional lazy loader.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Icon family in kebab-case or upstream snake_case.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Positive pixel size; omitted inherits 1em. Selects the nearest available optical design.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Accessible image name. Omit for decorative icons.

members.name: refresh
members.description: Retry a failed request or refresh the icon.

events.name: icon-load
events.description: Bubbles and is composed. Detail contains name and actual design variant/size.

events.name: icon-error
events.description: Bubbles and is composed. Detail contains name and error.

cssProperties.name: --fluent-icon-size
cssProperties.description: CSS length overriding visual width and height. Does not change optical design selection.

cssParts.name: svg
cssParts.description: The SVG element in the open shadow root.

cssParts.name: skeleton
cssParts.description: Placeholder shown while a lazy family import is in flight. Absent for cached icons.
